text_block_list.text:
Just as she has since her debut, Agnes 
Tachyon continues to put research above 
all else.

To help her shine on the Classic circuit, 
the Trainer mapped out a comprehensive 
three-year racing plan.

Upon seeing the plan, she made it clear 
that she would decide which races to enter 
on her own, prioritizing her research 
above all else.

However, the Trainer's efforts succeeded 
in directing her attention toward the 
Classic races and their trial race, the 
Yayoi Sho.
